# deed_project (Data Source)

Reads a Deed project by name or ID (any project the token can read).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "deed_project" "homelab" {
  name = "homelab"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Project ID (`prj_…`).
- `name` (String) Project name.

### Read-Only

- `allow_http_links` (Boolean) Whether plain http:// links are allowed.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `role` (String) The token's effective role in the project: `viewer`, `editor` or `admin`.
- `synthetic` (Boolean) Whether the project is synthetic (created by Deed for imported data).
